Archive the exact terms, service model version, request ID, input rights, and enterprise data-use terms for each generation batch.

Official SVD is not generically CC BY. Review the exact checkpoint license, revenue conditions, acceptable-use restrictions, input rights, and whether the planned discriminative-detector training is permitted.
